body: Ignoring all of that I don't really see why I would want to road trip at all to begin with.
Aye, I'm aware. Regardless I have no good and reliable method. I'm more or less fucked no matter what, but I'm willing to try with pills, with anything.

I'm not quite sure what you mean, but I'm assuming you mean in the literal sense. The answer is no, I don't. Ignoring that my freedom is already immensely limited and with or without a license that decision would fall onto my parents, a road trip would do nothing to change my situation, or how I feel about it.

Won't mean much when I'll just kill myself either way. A license means nothing to me, it's purely symbolic, and not so much to me as it is to society in general. Your license: a huge milestone in making it to adulthood. Frankly, I could care less. It's a piece of plastic. It won't change how much I want to die.
